title: Burgerbibliothek Bern, Erlach / Bernhard of Saxe-Weimar papers: letters and reports 'z.T. chiffriert' (Morshauser, Marti, 'P.J.H.', Coucault, Wicquefort, Schauenburg, Behr von Lahr)
correspondents: Paul Morshauser, Peter Marti, Jacques de Coucault, Joachim Wicquefort, J.R. von Schauenburg and others -> Duke Bernhard of Saxe-Weimar / Hans Ludwig von Erlach / Georg Wolker / Johann von Beck / Maximilian of Bavaria
folio_note: Morshauser 1637: '3 Kopien (Berichte) chiffriert' (XXVII.85, .92); Marti 1637: '4 Orig. Briefe, z.T. chiffriert' (XXVII.87); Coucault to Erlach 1617-18: '21 Orig.Briefe, z.T.chiffriert' (XXVII.81); Wicquefort 1638 (XXVII.88 no. 74); Schauenburg 1645 (XV.32 no. 49); Behr von Lahr 1648 (XXVII.78 no. 13)
status: Burgerbib catalogue (digitised Korrespondenzkartei) says 'chiffriert' / 'z.T. chiffriert' for each unit. No decipherment mentioned; the cards warn the entries may be incomplete.
why: Several authors writing in cipher to the Weimar army command and to Erlach, Bernhard's general, in 1637-39 plus a Coucault run of 1617-18; a Bernese archive not swept before. A shared correspondent set is good for a joint solve.
score_note: Scored from catalogue text only; the images online are index-card thumbnails, not the letters.
verify: Ask Burgerbibliothek (bbb@burgerbib.ch) for scans of Mss.h.h.XXVII.85/87/92; check the Erlach and Bernhard editions for printed decipherments.
source: Swiss cantonal sweep (Burgerbib scopeArchiv full text)
access_note: record online; letters not digitised (card thumbnails only); scans on request
